name: GrandBot
tagline: Turns an official bot export into a readable brief on how your org works
description: Takes the export file that xAI produces for your bots and reads it back to you as an organisational summary. Rather than a raw dump, you get a picture of what already exists, who owns which piece, and how it all fits together, so a newcomer can be handed the institutional memory. Published as open source.
author: suddenlyjon
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
